text: dsh-node-repl（DSH 网页插件）为每个会话提供一个浮动 Node REPL 终端。它在会话标题操作区添加 REPL 按钮，并通过 WebSocket 将浏览器终端连接到主机进程中的 node:repl；REPL 上下文包含当前 agent 的 ctx 和 agent。用户可在终端输入 JavaScript、查看输出，并调整、折叠或关闭窗口；断开后可重新连接现有会话。适合需要在 DSH 会话中直接运行 Node 表达式并访问当前 agent 上下文的用户。源码未显示外部服务或 API 密钥要求。

dsh-node-repl adds a floating Node REPL to each DSH web session. Click the session header button to open a browser terminal connected to an in-process node:repl with the current agent and ctx available. Enter JavaScript, resize or collapse the window, then reattach if disconnected.
想在 DSH 的每个会话里打开一个 JavaScript REPL 终端
如何在聊天会话中直接运行 Node 表达式并访问当前 agent 上下文？
I want an in-session Node console that can access the active agent context.
dsh-node-repl 的功能「会话内 Node REPL」：点击会话标题区的 REPL 按钮打开终端，输入 JavaScript 并查看输出；REPL 上下文包含当前 agent 和 ctx。
dsh-node-repl 的功能「终端窗口与会话控制」：在会话终端中可拖动和调整窗口大小，折叠时保留会话；关闭按钮会请求关闭主机侧 REPL，WebSocket 断开后可重新连接已有会话。

dsh-node-repl README · dsh-node-repl：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-node-repl)

Per-session **Node REPL terminal** for the DSH web UI. Open a real Node.js REPL
inside any conversation — with the live agent context (`ctx`, `agent`) in scope.

dsh-node-repl README · Features：- A **REPL** button in every session header opens a floating terminal window,
  local to that session (no global overlay, no conversation space taken).
- A real `node:repl` prompt — Tab completion, up/down history, top-level `await`,
  ANSI colors, `.help` / `.editor`.
- The live agent context is in scope: `ctx` (= `agent.ctx`) and `agent`, so
  `ctx.plugin`, `ctx.effect`, `ctx.get`, `ctx.on`, `ctx.provide` all work — plus
  the usual Node globals (`require`, `process`, `console`, `fetch`, …).
- Draggable and resizable window; collapse keeps the REPL alive, close kills it.

dsh-node-repl README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-node-repl
```

Restart `dsh web`, and the **REPL** button appears in each session header.

dsh-node-repl README · Usage：Open a session, click **REPL**, and type JavaScript. Top-level `await` works:

```js
> 1 + 1
2
> await Promise.resolve(42)
42

dsh-node-repl README · Window controls：| Control                      | Effect                         |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Header `REPL` button         | open / restore / collapse      |
| Title bar `–`                | collapse (keep the REPL alive) |
| Title bar `✕`                | close (kill the REPL)          |
| Drag the title bar           | move the window                |
| Drag the bottom-right corner | resize                         |

dsh-node-repl README · Window controls：The REPL belongs to its session: refreshing the page, dropping the WebSocket, or
disposing the agent kills it (reopen to start fresh).

dsh-node-repl README · Notes：The REPL runs **inside the DSH host process** (not in a child), which is how it
reaches the live `agent.ctx`. That also makes it a fully-trusted local tool: code
runs unsandboxed and can hang the process — treat it like a shell on that process.

dsh-node-repl README · Development：Requires [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) and Node ≥ 22. Build outputs (`lib/`) are
generated, not committed.

```sh
pnpm install   # installs deps and builds (prepare)
pnpm build     # rebuild host (tsc) + client bundle (esbuild)
pnpm test      # PTY/REPL bridge smoke test
pnpm lint      # eslint
